flags.item: No league-wide official depth chart exists.
flags.verified: nfl.com publishes team rosters and schedules, but no league-wide starter/backup chart. Individual clubs publish charts on their own sites.
flags.unknown: Whether a club chart is authoritative. Detroit's page says '2026 Unofficial Depth Chart'; Green Bay's says 'Unofficial, Nov. 10, 2026'.
flags.settles_it: Owner decision Q-05 on the acceptable verification tier; or a licensed depth feed.

flags.item: Depth charts collected for 5 of 32 clubs only.
flags.verified: BUF, SEA, DET, GB and BAL charts were read and transcribed row by row on 2026-11-14.
flags.unknown: The remaining 27 clubs. Their depth fields are deliberately blank, not inferred.
flags.settles_it: Q-14: extend capture to all 32 clubs under a stated cadence.
flags.source_label: Buffalo Bills depth chart (one of five captured)

flags.item: No odds, prices or historical lines exist in this repository.
flags.verified: Nothing in the repo contains a price. NFL.com articles cite a commercial book with a timestamp, which is a third-party snapshot and not a licensed feed.
flags.unknown: Every fair line, edge, expected value and closing-line value. All are therefore unpublished.
flags.settles_it: Q-02: a licensed quote feed with timestamps and limits.
flags.source_label: NFL.com picks page (odds attributed to a commercial sportsbook)

flags.item: No strategy has been scored, and the leaderboard is empty by design.
flags.verified: Validation gates, ranking objective and reward structure are specified and machine-readable in data/gates.json.
flags.unknown: Whether any candidate strategy has skill. Publishing a ranking now would be fabrication.
flags.settles_it: A scored test window under Q-12 after Q-01 and Q-02 are resolved.

flags.item: No correlation value is published, and none can be yet.
flags.verified: The estimator, the power calculation and the multiple-comparison correction are documented in docs/methodology/correlation.md.
flags.unknown: Every rho and every joint probability. Detecting rho = 0.10 needs roughly 780+ paired observations before conditioning.
flags.settles_it: Q-10: multiple seasons of licensed joint player-market outcomes.
flags.source_label: Current official snapshot — the only verified data held

flags.item: Sportradar's status as exclusive official NFL data distributor is reported, not read off an NFL.com page here.
flags.verified: Multiple independent outlets report the 2015 appointment and 2019 expansion to sportsbook operators.
flags.unknown: The current contractual text in 2026. It may have changed since the sources describing it.
flags.settles_it: A primary NFL or Sportradar release for the current term, or legal advice.

flags.verified: Branches arena/a78e0158-x1, arena/226be516-x1 and arena/6f377170-x1 exist. a78e0158 marked all tasks done while pushing no artifacts.

flags.item: The published 2026-11-14 standings are already false for 2 of 32 clubs.
flags.verified: The official nfl.com standings page, read live on 2026-11-15, shows DET 7-2-0 (PF 257, PA 199, net +58, 5W) and NE 5-5-0 (PF 221, PA 242, net -21, 2L). The published data/nfl/standings.tsv says DET 6-2-0 (222/189/+33, 4W) and NE 5-4-0 (211/207/+4, 1L). Both differences are the one Munich game, which the official Game Center reports as NE 10 - DET 35, Final. 12 of 256 compared cells differ; the other 30 clubs are identical.
flags.unknown: Whether the site should serve a dated snapshot (what it does now, correctly labelled 2026-11-14) or track the live page. That is a product decision, not a data one.
flags.settles_it: The diff is already published beside the table (data/verification/2026_11_15/standings_diff.json). The remaining choice is whether the landing page should show the snapshot date more loudly, and whether a scheduled capture at a fixed UTC hour should replace the ad-hoc one.
flags.league_source_label: Game Center: NE 10 - DET 35, Final, Munich

flags.item: A live game page shows a box score that is not a result, and any scraper that reads it will record a false final.
flags.verified: At 2026-11-15T18:1x UTC the official Week 10 schedule page listed KC@ATL, HOU@CLE, MIN@GB, MIA@IND, CAR@NO, BUF@NYJ and JAX@TEN as in progress with the score reading 0-0 for every one of them, at the same moment the same page showed NE 10 - DET 35 as Final. A parser that keys on 'a score is present' would write nine 0-0 finals into the results feed.
flags.unknown: How long the 0-0 window lasts on each game, and whether the feed flips to a real score before or after the game is marked Final.
flags.settles_it: Settle results only on the page's explicit Final status AND a Game Book PDF existence check, never on the presence of a score. The Munich game already exposes its Game Book at static.www.nfl.com/image/upload/v1794764592/gamecenter/ab582c2f-4feb-11f1-abca-2c54536568a9.pdf.
flags.league_source_label: Game Center with Game Book link

flags.item: The published 2026-11-14 Week 10 injury table is stale against the official page: 345 rows published vs 347 on 2026-11-17, with 34 line-level differences.
flags.verified: A live re-read of https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/reg10 on 2026-11-17 (22:50-22:56 UTC, chunks 0-7 of 8) transcribed 347 rows and matches the retained collector capture cell for cell (347 rows x 4 fields, 0 differences; capture read 2026-11-16T19:02:14Z, content unchanged at the 2026-11-17T19:49:49Z re-read). It also matches, cell for cell, the independent same-day transcription published in PR #73 (session arena/16049865-x1; check I2b, 0 differences). Versus the published data/nfl/injuries_week10.tsv (retrieved 2026-11-14T17:02Z, 345 rows): 2 rows added (BAL Calais Campbell, BAL Ronnie Stanley) and 32 cells changed across 16 rows - BAL 4 cells (Adam Randall, Jaylinn Hawkins), IND 2 cells (Arden Key), LAC 26 cells. The whole difference was already present in the 2026-11-15T18:14Z capture (PR #73 reports the 2026-11-15 and 2026-11-17 reads identical), so the drift window is 2026-11-14T17:02Z to 2026-11-15T18:14Z - the game-status designation deadline around the first Sunday slate - not a moving target since. NOTE on units: PR #73's headline '16 cells that differ' counts CHANGED ROWS (15 in LAC@BAL + Arden Key); counted cell by cell the same evidence is 32 cells. Row by row: data/verification/2026_11_17/injuries_diff_vs_published_2026_11_17.csv.
flags.unknown: Whether the site should republish a refreshed main table or keep serving the dated 2026-11-14 snapshot with dated packs beside it. That is a serving decision, not a data one; the snapshot itself is correctly labelled.
flags.settles_it: The dated 2026-11-17 pack, the 34-cell diff, and the two-session cell-for-cell agreement are already published. The remaining choice is the owner's: refresh data/nfl/injuries_week10.tsv through the collector under a stated cadence, or keep dated snapshots as the source of truth (which keeps F-22 open by design).

flags.item: With Week 10 complete, the published 2026-11-14 standings differ from the official page in 130 fields across 26 of 32 clubs (F-20 measured 2 clubs on 2026-11-15; this is the same staleness after the rest of the week).
flags.verified: The official league standings page read live on 2026-11-17 (~22:50 UTC) transcribes all 32 clubs with passing arithmetic (PCT, NET, HOME+ROAD=W-L-T) and equals the retained collector standings payload from 2026-11-17T05:03:50Z (256+96 assertions, 0 differences). Versus published data/nfl/standings.tsv (2026-11-14): 130 field changes - w x13, l x13, pct x26, pf x26, pa x26, streak x26 - affecting every club that played in Week 10 except WAS and NYG (their Thursday final was already in the 2026-11-14 table). The closure published+13 finals = today's W/L/PF/PA passes for all 32 clubs (128 assertions). Versus the previous dated read (2026-11-16): only BAL and LAC, 16 fields - the Monday-night game. Files: data/verification/2026_11_17/standings_diff_vs_published_2026_11_17.csv and standings_diff_vs_2026_11_16.csv. flags.unknown: Same open product decision as F-20: serve a dated snapshot (current, correctly labelled) or track the live page. F-20 asked this when 2 clubs were affected; the number that has changed is now 26 clubs / 130 fields.
flags.settles_it: Owner picks the serving model. Evidence for that choice is published: two dated deltas (11-16 and 11-17) plus a closure proof that the drift is exactly the played games, not transcription error.
flags.league_source_label: Game Center: the Monday-night final that closed Week 10

flags.item: The Week 11 injury report does not exist yet: on 2026-11-17 the Week 11 URL resolved to the Week 10 page, so no Week 11 availability value can be verified today.
flags.verified: Probe at approximately 2026-11-17 22:50 UTC: a fetch of https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/REG11 returned the fetch tool's final URL as https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/reg10 with the Week 10 title, and the printed season selector on that page lists WEEK 1 through WEEK 10 only. flags.item: A single fetch of the injury page can return a cell that the immediately repeated fetch contradicts; publishing from one read would publish the divergence.
flags.verified: During this session's 2026-11-17 transcription, the FIRST fetch of chunk 5 of the Week 10 injury report printed CIN Brian Parker II with game_status 'Questionable'; an immediate repeat fetch of the same chunk printed 'Doubtful'. 'Doubtful' is also printed by the retained collector capture at ten read times (2026-11-16T19:02:14Z through 2026-11-17T19:49:49Z, content hash c3d7a722...) and by the published 2026-11-14 table. The transcription records 'Doubtful' and the pack's I2 gate (347 rows x 4 fields against the capture) passes with zero differences; the divergence is recorded in the TSV header, not smoothed away silently.
flags.unknown: How often the rendered page diverges between two fetches minutes apart, why (edge cache vs live render), and whether an undetected divergence has ever reached a published table in an earlier session.
flags.settles_it: Never publish from a single fetch: require an immediate repeat read plus equality against the retained capture before a row reaches a page (gate I2 does this for this pack), and sample a chunk twice per scheduled run to measure the divergence rate over a season.
flags.league_source_label: the player row the two fetches disagreed on

flags.item: The third-party mirror's bytes moved between two fetches 21 minutes apart, so a cross-check is only meaningful against a named fingerprint.
flags.verified: On 2026-11-17 the same URL (api.github.com/repos/nflverse/nfldata/contents/data/games.csv) returned 2 190 571 B / sha256 0c643fd014305eeb at 22:44:27Z with no score for the six Sunday Week 10 games, and 2 190 568 B / sha256 5a61d3121f2178ce at 23:05:12Z with all 14 Week 10 scores. The first fetch would have made the closure look like a 13-of-14 mirror agreement.
flags.unknown: How long the upstream lags the league after a game ends, and whether it ever revises a score after publishing it.
flags.settles_it: tools/verify_2026_11_17.py V9 fails if the file on disk stops matching data/raw_manifest.json, and tools/build_snapshots.py refuses to build prices from unpinned bytes. A lag measurement needs the collector to fetch on a schedule and record both hashes.
flags.source_label: nflverse/nfldata games.csv (the same bytes, fetched via api.github.com twice on 2026-11-17)
